_meta.description: Raw SIMBAD facts for every OpenNGC-derived catalogue object whose OpenNGC Type mapped to 'other' (ambiguous Neb/Cl+N/DrkN/Other). This file stores facts only (SIMBAD's main otype code and its full otype list) -- the RECLASSIFICATION RULE lives in build_catalogue.py (GALAXY_OTYPES / OTHER_OTYPE_MAP / Builder.apply_simbad_reclassification), not here, so the rule stays versioned, auditable code rather than a value baked into this cache. This file is a committed, offline cache: the build does not query SIMBAD live.
_meta.source: SIMBAD (https://simbad.u-strasbg.fr), sim-script batched 'query id <designation>' with format directive '%IDLIST(1)||%OTYPE(3)||%OTYPELIST(3)'. otype3 is SIMBAD's main/primary object type for that designation; otype_list is every type code on record for it (an object can genuinely be more than one thing -- a star cluster embedded in an HII region is both).

retry_pass.description: The bare designation token failed to resolve for 2 objects whose OpenNGC row has a Common name; retried once with that Common name as the query (SIMBAD does not index Barnard dark-nebula numbers like "B33" unambiguously -- bare "B33"/"B 33" match 3 different catalogs (GC, Batten, Barnard) and SIMBAD refuses to guess; it does not index Caldwell numbers like "C99" at all, under any spacing). Cross-checked: of the 313 objects that failed the first pass, only these 2 have any OpenNGC Common name to retry with -- the other 311 have none, consistent with them being genuinely obscure/unconfirmed IC or NGC designations rather than a batching or parsing defect (independently verified: a fresh, differently-sized re-query of a random 40-object sample of the not_found set reproduced 40/40 failures with fully sequential, unmisaligned error numbering).
